text:
maria: Quick sync — aligning Dedicated roadmap for Q3 pilot (reserved pools + burst/autoscale). Agenda: 1) customer asks 2) autoscale policy 3) launch criteria 4) telemetry/observability. Need decisions by EOD Friday. Any blockers?

aj: +1. My initial policy proposal:
- target_util = 0.7
- min_pool = customer_commit / (1 - 0.15 headroom)
- scale_step = 1 GPU
- cooldown = 90s
- soft_spill before hard eviction
Fallback: route to compatible cheaper model variant (quantized) when the pool is saturated. Thoughts?

liam: infra note: GPUs are provisioned in 1-GPU units in the pilot cluster. Cold-start latency for new GPU instances ~ 45–60s depending on image. Preemption window for spot-like capacity is ~2m. That makes very short cooldowns risky.

sophia: customer ask summary from acct call: Enterprise A wants predictable burst for business hours (08:00–16:00 PT), committed baseline 200 req/s, needs burst to 1k for up to 3 contiguous hours/day. They want a soft SLA on burst hit rates and a canary before GA.

harry: Launch criteria proposal:
- Functional: reserved pool creation UI + API, autoscale policy config exposed, fallback model routing
- SLOs: P95 infer latency <350ms on committed traffic, P99 <800ms when bursted
- Reliability: eviction rate <0.5% of sessions/day, no data-plane 5xx >0.1%
- Observability: per-tenant P95/P99, token/sec, spillover count, model-fallback counts
- Rollout: 2 pilot tenants -> 10 customers -> GA

aj: config sketch (for prod autoscaler):
```
autoscale:
  target_util: 0.7
  min_pool_gpus: 2
  max_pool_gpus: 20
  scale_step_gpus: 1
  cooldown_seconds: 90
  burst_window_seconds: 10800 # 3 hours
  soft_spill_threshold: 0.95
  fallback_model: model-quant-6b
```

liam: we should clamp max_pool_gpus per-tenant to avoid noisy neighbors. Also add proactive warm-up: if predicted traffic >80% of capacity for next 5m, spin up 1 GPU earlier.

maria: decision call: agree to pilot with these constraints: no hard preemption on pilot, enable soft_spill + fallback routing, telemetry must be in place before pilot starts. Owner: @aj for autoscaler impl, @liam for infra provisioning, @sophia for customer coordination. Timeline: MVP for pilot in 3 sprints.

sophia: I'll schedule canary windows with Enterprise A next Tue/Wed mornings. Will need runbook for spill/fallback handling.

harry: who owns contract wording for burst? we need to specify what 'burst allowance' means (sustained vs. peak) to avoid billing surprises.

maria: @harry can you draft the burst SLA paragraph? I'll coordinate with sales on limits. Also add acceptance criteria to the ticket: a) runbook and playbook in docs, b) sample telemetry dashboard, c) automated regression test tied to canary.

aj: added to RFC draft: https://rwd.internal/rfc/dedicated-autoscale (will attach config examples & canary plan). Please review.

deploy-bot: Ticket #DCD-121 opened for pilot delivery, ETA 2025-05-12. Assigned: aj, liam, sophia, harry.

maria: ok let's reconvene after RFC comments. If no major objections I'll lock this plan by Friday. :thumbsup:
